title: New jobs compute will soon default to Auto access mode for workspaces with the compliance security profile enabled
body:
Starting in December 2026, new jobs compute created in the UI will default to **Auto** access mode in workspaces with the [compliance security profile](/aws/en/security/privacy/security-profile) enabled. Auto uses **Standard** access mode unless a machine learning runtime, a GPU instance type, or a Databricks Runtime version lower than 14.3 is selected. A cluster policy that enforces a different access mode still takes precedence. Existing jobs are not changed.

See [Use standard access mode](/aws/en/jobs/run-classic-jobs#use-standard-access-mode).
